'''Koren Buck''' was a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]]. He used to play himself up as [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] greatest warrior. He demanded only 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] up front for his services, with 800 upon completion of a successful job. However, he simply took the 200 credits and ran off with them.<ref name="PC" />
